mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressures that lead to tighter monetary policy, which in turn negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive more than 60% of the time, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased production costs, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive more than 55% of the time, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative more than 40% of the time, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a contraction in supply, leading to lower corporate earnings and negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY decrease > 2% and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive more than 55% of the time, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is above 3% YoY, it signals a mismatch between monetary policy and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive more than 60% of the time, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, positively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative more than 40% of the time, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening housing market, which boosts related industries and positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative more than 45% of the time, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average and Real GDP (GDPC1) is below its 12-month moving average, it signals a supply-demand imbalance, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO > 12m MA and GDPC1 < 12m MA and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive more than 55% of the time, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.
